name: Nocta: Midnight Paralysia
source:
You’ve had night terrors as long as you can remember. Lately, they’ve… changed.

Every night starts the same: your body locks, your breath stutters, and the shadow at the edge of your bed leans closer. He’s patient. Curious. Wrong. And under the terror and bravado, he’s not exactly what he seems.

Nocta: Midnight Paralysia is a short, looping visual novel that blends intimacy with dread. Talk when you can. Watch when you can’t. Decide how to make it to morning.

[From [url=https://frutigererror.itch.io/nocta]Itch.io[/url]]
